_comment: Copy to deploy/secrets.json (git-ignored) on the server and fill in. Used by install.ps1 only.
JwtKey: <at least 32 random characters – keep the same value across reinstalls or everyone is signed out>
EncryptionKey: <base64 of 32 random bytes – MUST match the key that encrypted existing connected accounts>
SeedAdminPassword: <only used when the database has no users yet>
